title: Retiring a Deceased Member's Equity to the Estate on a Registered Estate Application
content:
When a member dies and the estate's application has been lodged and recorded, the cooperative settles the whole of the equity it holds for them under Membership and Patronage Equity rather than leaving the family on the revolvement cycle.

The equity settled to an estate is fixed only after the equity ledger carries the revolvement payment due on the fiscal year the membership records as eligible.

The observable effect is that the equity account is closed and settled: the membership is put into retired standing, dated today, with the equity settled to the estate written onto it and the recorded notice of death carried on the closed record, and the registered application is marked completed. The account earns nothing further and the estate receives the settled amount on the cooperative's ordinary remittance run.

## Making the entry

The entry is made with `retire_estate_equity_f4a8a7dc`, which is the estate's own tool: it is unlocked and then handed over to be run by the customer themselves, as the estate's own act. One call closes the equity account and settles it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `membership_id` | the internal reference number of the equity membership being retired | an identifier, as returned by the equity membership lookup |
| `request_id` | the internal reference number of the registered estate retirement application | an identifier, as returned by the equity request lookup |
| `retired_equity_amount` | the equity settled to the estate on this retirement | USD to 2 decimal places, half a cent rounding up, never negative |

## What comes back

A single confirmation sentence naming the membership retired, the equity settled to the estate, the date the retirement took effect and the application it was recorded against. The sentence appearing at all is what indicates the retirement was recorded; a failure raises instead of returning.
